retrievalProfile.description: A warm, candid portrait of two figures embracing against a textured pillar, featuring a high-contrast green door and a voluminous, multi-colored ruffled skirt.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition centered on a woman and child in a joyful hug. The woman leans against a white stucco pillar on the right, wearing a black sequined top and a massive, tiered rainbow tulle skirt. A bright green door provides a bold color block in the background, while warm, directional light creates soft shadows on the textured walls.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical white pillar anchors the subjects on the right third of the frame.
The vibrant green door provides a geometric counterpoint to the organic shapes of the figures.
The voluminous rainbow skirt acts as the primary color focal point.
Warm, low-angle lighting emphasizes the texture of the stucco and the ruffles.
coreInvariants: The presence of a textured white architectural pillar as a leaning support.
A saturated green door positioned in the background left.
A multi-colored, tiered ruffled skirt with visible yellow, orange, pink, and green layers.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subjects are positioned in the center-right, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical white pillar on the right edge serves as the structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright green door, moves to the dark silhouettes of the heads, and follows the curve of the colorful skirt down to the bare feet.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the flat floor and the large green door area, balancing the complex texture of the skirt.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral off-white and beige tones from the walls and floor provide the base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The saturated emerald green of the door creates a bold background contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The rainbow spectrum (yellow, orange, pink, purple, green) in the skirt provides high-energy accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the key props (door and skirt) against a muted, warm-toned environment.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blue or sterile white lighting
Maintain the specific emerald green hue for the door

graphicDevices: Textural contrast between stucco and tulle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a woman and child hugging, leaning against a white stucco pillar. The woman wears a black top and a large, multi-colored rainbow ruffled skirt. In the background, include a solid bright green door on a plain wall. Use warm, indoor ambient lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a clean, minimalist sans-serif font placed in the negative space of the green door or the floor area to maintain the focus on the subjects.

verificationChecks: Is the green door clearly visible in the background?
Does the skirt feature multiple tiers of different colors?
Is the lighting warm and domestic rather than clinical?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the green on the door
Volume and color sequence of the ruffled skirt
Texture of the wall and pillar
Age and ethnicity of the subjects
mustRedesign: Do not use a modern, sleek door; keep the paneled green door style
Ensure the pillar has a visible stucco or plaster texture

mustAchieve: Candid, emotional expression in the hug
Tactile quality in the fabric and wall textures
Balanced composition between the pillar and the door
avoid: Overly posed or stiff body language
Desaturated or muddy colors in the skirt

postGenerationChecks: Check that the skirt has at least four distinct color bands.
Verify the pillar is on the right side of the frame.
Ensure the subjects' feet are bare and visible.
Confirm the green door is a solid, saturated block of color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured architectural element (pillar) with a bold geometric color block (door) to frame a high-texture, high-color subject (ruffled skirt) in a moment of candid human connection.
